achievements.label: Internal mini-program development support

achievements.label: Daily operations execution
achievements.description: Handled routine internal operations, including JD.com price audits and the recording and escalation of pricing anomalies, helping maintain platform pricing standards.

achievements.label: Pet-industry media monitoring

achievements.label: Field events and on-site support

achievements.label: Qualification review and organization
achievements.description: Collected, preliminarily reviewed, and organized qualification documents for merchants joining JD.com, ensuring submissions were complete and compliant with platform requirements; processed applications for more than 2,000 merchants.

achievements.label: System entry and archiving
achievements.description: Uploaded, entered, and archived qualification documents in accordance with JD.com standards and established a standardized filing process that improved document retrieval and review efficiency.

achievements.label: Progress tracking and coordination
achievements.description: Tracked qualification reviews, coordinated with internal teams and merchants to obtain missing materials, and created real-time AI-powered visual charts that enabled managers to monitor progress.

achievements.label: Data reporting and analysis
achievements.description: Compiled qualification-management data, analyzed key indicators such as review cycles and issue categories, and prepared statistical reports to support process improvements.

achievements.label: Store operations and cross-functional collaboration
achievements.description: Maintained store information and core operating spreadsheets in the company backend while coordinating with supervisors and other departments. Reviewed and maintained records for more than 1,500 stores and reduced a 1,800+ store discrepancy between JD.com and the Meituan/Ele.me platforms to approximately 200 through systematic coordination and data reconciliation.

achievements.label: Rapid learning and adaptability
achievements.description: Quickly learned the metal-trading workflow and its key operating procedures through one week of intensive study despite having no prior industry background.

achievements.label: Trade documentation
achievements.description: Independently prepared and reviewed complete sets of trade documents, including quotations and delivery notes, ensuring accuracy and process compliance.

achievements.label: Cross-functional coordination
achievements.description: Served as a key liaison between internal and external parties by negotiating logistics plans with freight companies and confirming order details with clients to keep trade operations running smoothly.

achievements.label: Problem solving
achievements.description: Actively coordinated responses to unexpected logistics issues, identified practical solutions, and protected the company's interests and client relationships.

achievements.label: Document review and risk control
achievements.description: Professionally reviewed the completeness and authenticity of materials submitted by small and medium-sized enterprise clients, including corporate ownership structures, serving as the first line of risk control.

achievements.label: Information collection and verification
achievements.description: Collected first-hand client information and systematically organized and verified identity, qualification, and asset documentation to ensure a reliable information foundation.

achievements.label: Data processing and entry
achievements.description: Independently completed data collection, organization, entry, and validation throughout the credit application process, supporting accurate and efficient downstream approval.

summary.title: Professional Summary
summary.body: I bring a solid academic foundation and extensive hands-on experience, enabling me to adapt quickly to new environments and deliver work efficiently. I am optimistic, proactive, conscientious, and highly accountable, with strong execution skills. I learn quickly, welcome challenges, and take initiative in practical work. Rather than simply completing assigned tasks, I stay focused on outcomes and continually look for ways to improve processes. I regularly contribute suggestions, enjoy discussing the feasibility of ideas with teammates, and remain open to others' perspectives. I believe strong solutions emerge through collective discussion rather than individual effort. With effective communication and teamwork skills, I collaborate efficiently across departments to advance shared goals. I am especially motivated by the role of a hands-on execution lead: taking ownership of core tasks, driving implementation, and remaining accountable for the final outcome.
